description.value: Once per day, when you'd be reduced to 0 HP, automatically stabilize without needing to roll.

cinderfall.incomplete: The once-per-day 'automatically stabilize without rolling when reduced to 0 HP' trigger has no engine hook: nothing lets an item rule element intercept or override the built-in dying/stabilize sequence -- confirmed absence (the real Reactive Shield feat, which similarly grants use of an existing action, ships rules: [] for the same reason).
